title: Kevin Feige Highlights the X-Men's Role in Marvel's Next Era
excerpt:
Marvel's president describes Secret Wars as a launchpad for a new era.
The proposed reset is not a complete reboot of the MCU.
body_md:
Speaking to Entertainment Weekly, Kevin Feige described Avengers: Doomsday as a culmination of earlier stories and Secret Wars as a launchpad for a new era. The year 2028 will mark the MCU's twentieth anniversary.

Feige has previously characterized the transition as a reset rather than a complete reboot. His comments should not be read as confirmation that every existing character or storyline will be discarded.

He emphasized the importance of the X-Men alongside the Avengers and Spider-Man in Marvel's comics. Decades of stories offer opportunities to explore characters and sagas that have received less attention in earlier adaptations. Disney's acquisition of Fox enabled Marvel to develop its own approach to these properties.

The feed report lists X-Men, a Ryan Gosling Ghost Rider film and Black Panther III for 2028. Those scheduling details are reported rather than independently established by the interview excerpt. Potential projects involving teams such as X-Force remain speculation. Feige's central message is the importance of the mutants to Marvel's future.
